features.feature: Authenticated Computer Use helper, agent injection, tools, permission onboarding and lifecycle
gaps: No helper target, authenticated MCP injection, client approval profile or native TCC readiness owner
acceptance: Verify signed helper/client identity and stale credential denial
Exercise supported client tools, snapshot targeting and approval contracts
Prove permission denial/revocation, one-time onboarding, helper replacement and session cleanup

features.feature: Managed-device policy and live cross-entrypoint enforcement
gaps: No forced preference resolver, policy generation, UI locking or live revocation owner
acceptance: Forced values dominate config/env across UI/CLI/restore/remote entrypoints
Invalid restrictive policy fails closed; ordinary defaults cannot impersonate MDM
Live profile changes revoke affected clients, helpers, retries and transfers; removal restores user choice

features.feature: Project pane creation, parsing, inspection and routing
gaps: No project surface, project model/parser, open namespace or debug state contract
acceptance: CLI shorthand/explicit open resolve cwd/workspace/window/focus and return exact IDs
Malformed/missing projects and close-during-load fail safely
Files/targets/build-settings/schemes state and build-specific debug exposure agree

features.feature: Quit, confirmation, deferred cleanup and relaunch lifecycle
gaps: Asynchronous shutdown exists; missing dirty-workspace confirmation, session snapshot and update/remote cleanup contract
acceptance: Cmd-Q/menu/system/update requests share one cancellation and teardown owner
Repeated quit does not duplicate dialogs or cleanup
Bounded owned cleanup and fresh recoverable state preserve unrelated processes
